free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: witness fixes q_len/batch_size but not the head count; one q head keeps the CPU run minimal and the branch does not depend on heads

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: witness does not fix kv heads; one kv head matches num_q_heads so no GQA expansion is needed before or after the target

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: required positional argument of the entry; its value is irrelevant to the q_len == 1 branch

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: default block size of the entry; the q_len == 1 branch is decided before any block logic

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU has no bf16 Triton kernels; the q_len branch does not depend on the tensor dtype

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed makes the random tensor construction deterministic across runs

mocks.reason: after the q_len == 1 branch decision both runs reach this GPU flash-attention launcher; this CPU attention replaces only that post-target call
